concepts.def: Dead lignified vessels transporting water and minerals from roots upward via transpiration pull.
Living sieve tubes with companion cells; translocate sucrose from source to sink (Munch 1930 pressure flow).
Evaporative loss of water from leaves through stomata; creates tension drawing water column up.
Pores in epidermis flanked by guard cells; open when guard cells turgid via K+ uptake.
Photoreceptor pigment switching between Pr (red-absorbing) and Pfr (far-red) forms; controls flowering.
Plant hormone (IAA) promoting cell elongation and phototropism (Went 1926 oat coleoptile).

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Plant Biology.
